messages:
viv: FYI: Hosted API streaming + tool-calling v3 is GA and rolling out now. Short summary and a few ops/policy notes below. :loudspeaker:

omar: timeline? will v2 still work?

viv: Rolling across regions over 48 hours. /v2/toolcall will continue to operate for 30 days with Deprecation header; after that we'll automatically redirect non-custom clients to /v3 for another 14 days before fully shutting down v2. No API key changes.

junaid: Important policy change: streaming request logs (raw frames) retention default reduced to 30 days for hosted plans to limit sensitive-data exposure. Enterprise customers can request extended retention via private deployment add-on. Docs updated.

tara: Ops note: a small canary incident in us-west-2 produced intermittent 502s for tool-call streams this morning; root cause was a mis-specified proxy timeout on the canary path. Patch rolled and canary revalidated. Incident window ~12m, no data loss.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout hosted-toolcall-service us-west-2 - build=2026.04.08-1123, canary=true

ovar: (typo) meant to say thanks to the infra team who caught the proxy timeout.

junaid: SDK compatibility: official SDKs (python/js/go) map v3 frames into legacy shape when api_version is set to "v2" so most customers see no change. If you parse raw webhooks or use a custom proxy, update to new frame schema: {chunk: string, id: string, complete: bool, tool_meta: object|null}. See quick example in docs.

viv: Short migration snippet for Python SDK: `client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"), api_version="v3")
stream = client.tool_call.stream(task_id="summarize")
for frame in stream: handle(frame.chunk)`

tara: Observability: Console dashboard panels live (Toolcall V3): latency, frame-checksum-fails, webhook-4xx, detokenization-diff. Alerts pre-wired for >0.5% frame checksum failures and spike in incomplete frames.

omar: Marketing/comms: we'll send a tenant email to any org with >2k tool calls/day. High-touch account owners, please add tenant-specific notes by EOD. Executives: drop 1-2 sentence quotes to #marketing-distro if you want included.

junaid: Note on determinism: v3 detokenization is deterministic across retries so tool outputs should be stable with retries and fallbacks. This reduces flakiness for tool-based actions.

viv: Thanks everyone. If you find user-facing regressions, escalate to @eng-oncall and ping me. We'll post a formal external blog after rollout completes and the post-rollout SLO checks pass. :rocket:
